description: Symbol ids on one exchange matching every word of the query, at most 50: crypto and real-world asset (RWA) perpetuals alike. A word matches the id or the asset's name, so "TSLA", "Tesla", "gold", "S&P 500" and "crude oil" all work; exact tickers and names come first. Each result has its asset class (crypto, stock, etf, index, commodity, fx, pre-ipo, or rwa when the class is not known yet), the underlying's name where known, and a HIP-3 market's dex. Ids look like "perpetual-BTC-USDT:USDT", "perpetual-TSLA-USDT:USDT" for a tokenized stock on Binance, or "perpetual-XYZ:TSLA-USDC:USDC" for a Hyperliquid HIP-3 market (dex before the colon). The free preview symbols are perpetual-NVDA-USDT:USDT (the default) and perpetual-BTC-USDT:USDT, on binance-futures.

asset_class.description: Only symbols of this class: "crypto", one real-world class ("stock", "etf", "index", "commodity", "fx", "pre-ipo"), or "rwa" for every real-world asset.

query.description: Words to match against the id and the asset's name, e.g. "BTC USDT", "Tesla", "gold" or "XYZ TSLA". Empty lists the first 50.
